title: Sensex crashed 989 pts — but the midcap index went UP. Here's what the headlines missed. #Shorts
description:
Sensex crashed 989 points today. But the midcap index closed in GREEN.

The index tells one story. The breadth data tells another.

Today's snapshot:
📉 Sensex: −989 pts (−1.17%)
📉 Nifty 50: −277 pts (−1.07%)
📈 Nifty Midcap 150: +64 pts ↑
📉 IT sector: −1.88% (profit booking)
📈 Metal: +1.40%
🛢️ Crude oil: $95.31 — OPEC+ meets Nov 29

When heavyweight stocks drag an index down, your midcap and small-cap holdings can tell a completely different story. The Sensex headline is not your portfolio.
